title: Green Roofs: Stormwater Management From the Top Down
semantic: This paper discusses the role of green roofs in managing stormwater from a top-down perspective.

title: Hydrology of an extensive living roof under sub-tropical climate conditions in Auckland, New Zealand
semantic: The paper investigates the hydrological behavior of an extensive living roof in a sub-tropical climate, contributing insights on its effectiveness in stormwater management.

semantic: The paper explores the intersection of green-blue-grey infrastructure with sustainable urban flood risk management.

title: Water-retention additives increase plant available water in green roof substrates
semantic: This paper investigates the impact of water-retention additives on plant available water in green roof substrates, relevant for stormwater management.

title: Assessing practical measures to reduce urban heat: Green and cool roofs
semantic: This paper assesses the hygrothermal performance of extensive green roofs and their potential to mitigate urban heat and improve energy efficiency, contributing indirectly to stormwater management strategies in urban environments.
